morphology_descriptive_models.limitations: RSS is descriptive: median normalization, correlated noise, unequal model parameter counts; no formal model odds.

sector_timing_refit.limitations: Fixed trapezoid, giant variability and conditional correlation floor. This is not an orbital dynamics model.

limitations: All depth ratios are targeted and conditional, not calibrated global false-alarm probabilities.
QLP SAP errors use KSPSAP reported errors supplemented by event residual/HAC and event/sector scatter floors.
Native exposure smearing integrated; empirical five-cadence covariance excludes arbitrary long-time noise.
Unmasked quarter-phase controls include real eclipse tails in their baseline windows and manufacture template-like deficits; corrected controls mask both eclipse families.
2P with equal orbital cycles remains an unavoidable photometric alias in the absence of RV.
